clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rising as she lay awake over money in March 1988, her distance from your father as they stopped talking about money in May 1988, your brother's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work in March 1990. The shifts pile up across the death, with your mother's worry and distance from your father in the months before, your brother's functioning dropping after, and your mother's anxiety settling as she returned to work.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother Della's diagnosis of breast cancer in February 1995, within the following months: your migraines began keeping you in bed in March 1994, you called your brother most nights in April 1994, you stopped returning his calls in June 1995, and you stopped calling home in February 1996. Your symptoms and relationship shifts with your brother frame the months around her diagnosis; you drew toward him, then away, as the news and its aftermath moved through the family.
